source_caption:
🎬 Noelle (2019)

Noelle follows Noelle Kringle, the cheerful and optimistic daughter of Santa Claus, who has spent her entire life surrounded by the magic and traditions of Christmas at the North Pole. When her father retires and her older brother Nick struggles with the pressure of becoming the next Santa, Noelle encourages him to take a break. However, when Nick disappears just days before Christmas, she sets out on an unexpected adventure to find him and save the holiday. Traveling beyond the North Pole, Noelle discovers the challenges of the real world while learning more about her own abilities and purpose. Combining heartwarming comedy, magical adventures, and festive holiday moments, the film explores family, kindness, self-discovery, and the true meaning of Christmas.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Fantasy • Christmas

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 40m • G

🎥 Director: Marc Lawrence

🏆 Recognition: Starring Anna Kendrick, Bill Hader, Shirley MacLaine, and Billy Eichner, the film was released as a Disney+ original and became a family-friendly holiday favorite thanks to its charming performances and heartwarming Christmas story.

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+.

source_details.synopsis: Noelle is a 2019 American Christmas comedy film written and directed by Marc Lawrence, produced by Walt Disney Pictures and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures. The film stars Anna Kendrick, Bill Hader, Kingsley Ben-Adir, Billy Eichner, Julie Hagerty, and Shirley MacLaine with supporting roles done by Diana Maria Riva, Maceo Smedley, Jason Antoon, Michael Gross, and Billy Griffith. The film tells the story of the daughter of Santa Claus, who goes to look for her brother (who is next in line to become the new Santa Claus) when he does not return from a week off and enlists a private investigator to help find him.
